I really enjoy Peak at its core. It's a fun climbing game, relatively relaxing and with a focus on figuring out a solid path forward. Or, at least, that's how the game started out as. What it has morphed into steadily with each passing update however, is a game far more focused on 'crazy moments' and wacky events which have pushed aside the enjoyment of the core gameplay loop in favor of instant kills and frustrating hazards that aren't fun to deal with.

I was never a hardcore player of Peak but now I never will become one. Every time I get the urge to come back I'm reminded of all the new biomes that I just don't find fun to explore and thus any desire I have just evaporates. 

If you want something with wacky, crazy moments to play with friends then I can see the appeal for you. If you are like me though, stay away from this game unfortunately. Which sucks because there really isn't anything else like it.
